input: Research local mushroom foraging guided tours

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The user's location entirely determines which tours are available — without knowing the region or city, no relevant results can be found.
A specific target date or season affects which tours are actively running, since mushroom foraging is highly seasonal.
Whether this is for a solo trip, a couple, a family with children, or a group changes the type of tour to prioritise and the logistics involved.
Tour prices vary widely; knowing a budget ceiling narrows down the options and avoids wasted research on unaffordable tours.
The user may want a short introductory walk, a half-day tour, or a full-day immersive experience — this determines depth and format of what to look for.
Some users prioritise safety and education for beginners, while others want hands-on foraging with an expert chef or mycologist — this shapes which providers to highlight.
Knowing what the user wants to walk away with — a list of vetted options, a booking, a comparison table — defines what 'done' looks like for this research task.

gold.taskTitle: Research local mushroom foraging guided tours
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate guided mushroom foraging tours available in the user's local area.

questions.title: What city or region should the tours be near?
questions.description: Identify the geographic location to search within, since available tours depend entirely on where the user is based or willing to travel.

questions.title: What date or season are you targeting for the tour?
questions.description: Determine the intended timeframe so that only currently bookable, seasonally active tours are included in the research.

questions.title: How many people will be attending the tour?
questions.description: Clarify the group size and whether it includes children or mixed abilities, as this affects tour type and availability.

questions.title: What is your budget per person for the tour?
questions.description: Establish a price ceiling to filter out tours that are outside the user's spending range.

questions.title: Do you want a short walk, half-day, or full-day experience?
questions.description: Understand the desired duration and intensity of the tour so the right format is prioritised in the research.

questions.title: Is this more about learning identification or the cooking side?
questions.description: Identify whether the user leans toward mycology and species education vs. a culinary foraging experience, to match the right type of guide or operator.

questions.title: What should this research produce — a shortlist, comparison, or ready-to-book pick?
questions.description: Define what a successful output looks like so the research is scoped to the right level of detail and decision-readiness.
